sections.title: Solving Health Club Locker Room Odors
sections.content: High traffic, heavy sweat, and humidity create severe scaling and odor issues in gym locker rooms. Daily acid-free descaling paired with weekly bio-enzymatic drain dosing eliminates root odor sources before member complaints arise.

calloutContent: Learn how XIRI's 3-stage locker room protocol eliminates hard water scale, shower mold, and drain bio-film.

faqs.question: How do you handle cardio touchscreen equipment cleaning?
faqs.answer: We use alcohol-free, non-abrasive EPA disinfectants applied via micro-fiber wipes to sanitize touchscreens without causing display moisture damage.
